verification_notice: Verify against official source or qualified plant-pathology expert.

lesion_shape.description: Generic visible lesion-shape observation; it is not a confirmed disease rule.

lesion_colour.description: Generic observed lesion colour without inferring a diagnosis.

yellow_halo_present.description: Whether a yellow region appears to surround a visible lesion.

lesion_distribution.description: Generic spatial distribution of visible lesions.

vein_alignment.description: Whether visible symptoms appear aligned with leaf veins.

leaf_edge_involvement.description: Generic observation of whether visible symptoms involve the leaf edge.

leaf_surface.description: Leaf surface represented by the observation or image.

symptom_stage.description: Provisional visual stage observation without a disease-specific claim.

wet_or_dry_appearance.description: Generic appearance of the visible symptom region.

symptom_progression.description: User-observed change over time when known.

mixed_symptoms_possible.description: Whether more than one visual symptom pattern may be present.

pest_signs_present.description: Generic observation of possible pest signs without identifying a pest.

nutrient_deficiency_possible.description: Whether nutrient deficiency remains a possible non-disease explanation.

environmental_damage_possible.description: Whether environmental damage remains a possible explanation.

user_confidence.description: User confidence in the submitted observations, not diagnostic confidence.

symptom_notes.description: Optional concise notes; do not include unnecessary personal data or an invented diagnosis.
